name: address
label: Address
hint: Street, number, postal code, city. Example: 'Calle Example 12, 3A, 41000 Seville'.

name: contacts
label: Contacts
hint: Host phone numbers with messaging channels. Example: '+34 600 00 00 00 (WhatsApp, Telegram); +34 600 00 00 01 (WhatsApp)'.

name: check_in
label: Check-in
hint: Check-in window and arrival procedure. Example: 'From 15:00 to 22:00. Send arrival time and transport in advance (flight number if flying). On arrival call +34 600 00 00 00; we meet you at the apartment.'

name: check_out
label: Check-out
hint: Check-out time and tasks before leaving. Example: 'Before 11:00. Wash used dishes, close all windows and doors, turn off A/C and lights.'

name: wifi
label: Wi-Fi
hint: Network name and password. Example: 'Network: MyApartment / Password: changeme123'.

name: tourist_license
label: Tourist license
hint: Tourist license number as registered. Example: 'VUT/SE/00000'.

name: emergencies
label: Emergencies
hint: Emergency number plus nearby hospitals (address, notes). Example: '112 - police/ambulance/fire. City Hospital - Calle Example 1, private, doctor at home, telemedicine in 10 languages.'

name: pets
label: Pets
hint: Pet policy. Example: 'Cats, dogs and other pets are not allowed.'

name: keys
label: Keys
hint: Number of key sets and departure steps. Example: 'Two sets, 2 keys each (building + apartment). On departure leave keys on the table and pull the door shut. Do not leave keys in the lock.'

name: basic_rules
label: Basic rules
hint: Smoking, quiet hours, parties, energy saving. Example: 'No smoking or open flames inside (gas hob excepted). Quiet 22:00-10:00, no parties. Turn off A/C and lights when out.'

name: garbage
label: Garbage
hint: Indoor bins and public container locations/types. Example: '2 kitchen bins, take out daily. Public containers on Example Street: glass, paper, packaging, organic.'

name: appliances
label: Appliances
hint: Short per-appliance usage notes and warnings. Example: 'Gas hob: press & turn knob anti-clockwise, light with a lighter; off = vertical. Dishwasher: load, detergent in slot D, select program (P), Start. Coffee: Dolce Gusto capsules, wait for green light. A/C: ground floor by remote, bedrooms by wall panel.'

name: transport
label: Transport
hint: Airport and city transport with prices. Example: 'Airport bus to city centre, 5 EUR, ~35 min. Airport taxi flat 25 EUR (confirm with driver). Nearest metro: Example Station. Buses 00/01, stop Example.'

name: parking
label: Parking
hint: Nearby parking options. Example: 'Free street parking nearby; underground short-stay garage; paid municipal car park; long-term booking via a parking service.'

name: restaurants
label: Restaurants
hint: Recommended restaurants, tapas and bars. Example: 'Restaurant A - traditional Andalusian. Bar B - tapas. Rooftop C - cocktails with views.'

name: supermarkets
label: Supermarkets
hint: Nearest supermarket with hours. Example: 'Supermarket X, Calle Example, 9:00-21:30.'

name: lockers
label: Luggage storage
hint: Luggage storage options. Example: 'Luggage Storage Y, Plaza Example 13.'

name: additional_info
label: Additional info
hint: Free-form notes that don't fit other fields. Example: 'Spare blankets in the wardrobe. Mind the step at the entrance. Tap water is safe to drink.'
